title: Shared Artifact Firewall: prompt placeholders stop leaking across compiled outputs

claims.summary: The release does not claim 100/100; it targets a safe compiler-side artifact/source placeholder leak from the current quality evidence.
Shared lesson concept and artifact helpers now cover Study Guides, discussions, quiz-bank metadata, and compiled custom reflection/reading-response outputs.
Source-grounding extras and discussion source-artifact locators now pass through safe evidence-cue sanitization before rendering.
The regression proves polluted Project Management prompt labels are absent while safe project concepts and source-evidence language remain.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify whether quality losses remain source-license, partial-enrichment, texture, or PPTX format issues.
Continue source-ledger work until retrieved source-finder resources reliably become trusted concept-linked source-ledger rows.
Keep enrichment strict: if only 9/12 or 11/12 lessons enrich, retry within bounded repair budget or block earlier with clear repair evidence.
